# Tallinn

Welcome to Tallinn, where Pipedrive was born.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tallinn team!

See open positions

## About us

Pipedrive was born in Tallinn. What started as a small startup in a shared office has grown into an international company with an entire building in Tallinn’s vibrant WoHo quarter. Today, Tallinn is home to our engineering and product hub, where 300+ team members from 30+ nationalities work together – many of them engineers.

Pipedrive is proud to be Estonia’s fifth unicorn and has consistently been recognized as one of the best places in the country to work since 2016, according to both the media and our employees. And we’re not just about jobs – at Pipedrive, you’ll have the chance to grow, learn and make a real impact by helping shape a product used by more than 100,000 companies worldwide.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive, we love to celebrate the moments that matter – from birthdays and work anniversaries to promotions. One of our most beloved traditions is getting together for *Kringle*, a classic Estonian pastry, though you’ll also see pizza, donuts or pancakes make an appearance. To make sure no celebration goes unnoticed, we’ve got a kitchen-alert Slack channel to keep everyone in the loop.

Our biggest annual event is the Summer Garage – a full-day celebration that brings teams together to connect, unwind and enjoy live music performed by our very own band (and sometimes a guest artist or two).

We also host occasional hackathons and innovation accelerators to spark new ideas for improving the product and how we work together.

We believe in a balance of fun and focus. From Lightning Talks where anyone can practice their presentation skills with a topic they care about, to Sudoku tournaments and gaming challenges organized by teammates, there’s always something to get involved in.

We’re also proud to contribute to the wider community: Our team actively supports the local engineering, product and HR scenes in Estonia by hosting in-house meetups, participating in conferences and speaking at events.

Staying active outside of work is also a big part of our culture. Whether it's a friendly game of table tennis, a disc golf match or a padel session – one of the most popular sports among our Tallinn team – there's always fun going on.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Tallinn’s modern WoHo district, where our custom-designed office makes it easy to feel at home. Each of our eight themed floors – park, nature, sports, IT, music, art, movies and culture – is fully immersive. Whether you’re jamming on the music floor’s instruments or exploring the art gallery, there’s something for everyone.

The heart of the office is our all-hands area, where people gather for a coffee or something else from our well stocked kitchens. Think smoothies with frozen berries, cereal, fruit, nuts, all kinds of milk, teas and sodas. If you're into fitness or want to unwind, we’ve got a fully equipped gym and an igloo sauna you

# Berlin

Hallo! Welcome to our Berlin office, located in the European capital for innovation and digitization.

See open positions

## About us

Welcome to Pipedrive Germany, our vibrant new hub right in the heart of Berlin!

Opened on November 23, 2021, it’s now home to 30+ professionals from 15+ countries, all united by a passion for marketing and product development.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive Berlin, we believe that a strong team is built not just on passion for our work, but also on the joy of spending time together. With our diverse roots and cultural backgrounds, we bond over cuisine evenings, sharing everything from tasty tacos to Georgian dumplings. Plus, we love to bring back tasty souvenirs from our travels – nothing brings a team together like food!

We’re all about exploring the city and soaking in the local culture, too! Join us for PipeHikes in the Berlin countryside, scenic boat trips along the Spree and annual Oktoberfest celebrations at our favorite brewery. We’ll also end the year on a high with our winter award show featuring laughter, creative sketches and special appearances from our kids, pets, and even our customers!

## Where you’ll find us

Our office is nestled in the bustling Mitte district, boasting incredible public transport links and an endless array of amazing restaurants and coffee spots for food lovers. Our bright and lively office space is designed to spark creativity and camaraderie, complete with comfy couches, an Xbox, and a ping-pong table in our All Hands area – perfect for game nights and team bonding. And yes, we’re a dog-friendly office, so your furry friend can join the fun!

Step into our cozy meeting rooms, each uniquely named after our favorite local dishes (including Currywurst and Döner), where teammates come together to brainstorm and collaborate. Our kitchen is always stocked with Berlin’s best snacks and beverages – including the legendary Club-Mate – to keep the creative energy flowing!

Čau! Welcome to our friendly office in the capital of Latvia! Join the Pipedrive family.

## About us

Before becoming Pipedrive Latvia, our office in the capital Riga was the home base for the team behind Mailigen, an intuitive email automation platform. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Riga, the team of more than 20 employees joined the Pipedrive family in 2020. Mailigen is the first acquisition in Pipedrive history and brings sales and marketing teams closer together.

Our team in Riga helps companies rise and tell their stories through email!

Pipedrive Latvia is a great place to grow and develop yourself in a positive and enthusiastic work environment. We have a friendly team of young professionals from diverse backgrounds, and we aim to become the best workplace in Latvia. Would you like to be part of it?

Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

The team's mission is to build the definitive AI-Native Open Source Data Platform. They are integrating best-of-breed open-source technologies - starting with data governance and discovery (DataHub) and moving into unified federated querying - to deliver a seamless data experience in minutes, not months.

Every AI insight, every experiment, every cohort at Amplitude starts with a query. Our in-house OLAP engine, **Nova**, processes trillions of events in real time — turning raw behavioral data into fast, trustworthy answers that power decisions for thousands of product teams worldwide.

We're entering a world where AI agents don't just assist product teams — they ship features, run experiments, and make prioritization calls autonomously. What makes that possible is agents' ability to verify their work against real product data continuously. That makes Nova the critical infrastructure in the loop, and as non-stop agents become the main source of queries, the demand on Nova's throughput, correctness, and operational rigor grows dramatically.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** who wants to go deep on the engine internals and the infrastructure underneath. You'll grow your technical influence through the quality of your code, your design contributions, and your collaboration with other engineers on a team of ~10.

This role is ideal for someone who finds real satisfaction in making a complex distributed system faster, cheaper, and more reliable — and who wants to do that work on a system that directly powers the product experience for thousands of enterprise customers.

## Senior Software Engineer - Analytics Compute Platform Team

## 

## About the Role & Team

Every chart, insight, and experiment result a customer sees in Amplitude passes through the compute layer that this team owns. Our team sits between Amplitude's front-end analytics products/ rest APIs/ MCPs and Nova, our proprietary analytics database, and owns the compute API that translates a user's question into a fast, correct answer.

Our mandate: **enable a highly performant, reliable, and flexible way to compute insights.** Those three goals are often in tension the more flexible we make the system, the harder it is to keep it fast and simple, and a lot of the interesting engineering work on this team lives in that tradeoff.

Day to day, you'll work closely with engineers on data management, marketing analytics, Session Replay, Experiment, CDP, Query, and various product teams, since they're all consumers of what we build.

## As a Senior Software Engineer, you will

* Design and build core parts of the query/compute engine that powers analysis across Amplitude's product suite
* Evolve the compute API and semantic layer that other engineering teams build features on top of, so that it can support a more generic table
* Help unify and evolve our core data model, including how non-event data (profile properties, lookup tables, etc.) is represented alongside event data
* Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of query planning and execution on the Amplitude query engine
* Partner with teams across Session Replay, Experiment, CDP, Query, and frontend to understand their needs and shape the compute layer around them
* Take ownership of projects end-to-end, from design through rollout
